_comment: Offline mock of the scale-only run. Free; tests the pipeline only. Output is NOT real data. Needs data_published/<sha12>/reserved_schemas.json (or a stand-in) from the importer.
_provenance: CONFIRMED from the published v2 manifests: sources schemas+jsb_schemas, max_schema_kb 10, seed 0, test_ratio 0.15 (these define the original training pool, so keep them). The ORIGINAL builder was openai/gpt-oss-120b; Granite is a different model. This run keeps the original generation logic, prompts, thresholds and schema pool but CHANGES the original one-example-per-schema policy (see docs/schema_reuse.md). The mock model has no sampling parameters.

reuse._comment: Controlled schema reuse (differs from the original one-example-per-schema policy). Each attempt mints an independent reference with the unchanged standard prompt; a reference equal to a published or earlier new one for that schema is rejected. Cap = max new references per schema (each feeds up to 3 tasks). A schema failing max_failures_per_schema attempts in a row sits out suspend_passes passes (max_suspensions times), then is retired for the run; the target is still pursued with other schemas. sampling_seed_param, e.g. "seed", would pass a per-attempt integer to the provider; left null because it is not verified for the Granite endpoint.
